metadata.pedal: Mesa Boogie Mark IIC+ (++) Preamp (virtual analog, LiveSPICE)

volume_gain.note: The preamp has no Volume knob. Master 1 is pinned at 0.5 (unity) in the render and Pull Lead is always ON. The plugin's Output knob is a post-network trim in dB (see Plugin.h outputGainFromDb).

metadata.note: Channel 0 is audio; channels 1.. are the knob values in `knobs` order. Master 1 and Pull Lead are pinned (not conditioned). Build that vector per audio sample and pass it to RTNeural::ModelT<float, N, 1, DenseT<float,N,H>, TanhActivationT<float,H>, GRULayerT<float,H,H>, DenseT<float,H,1>>. No post-network gain is applied: the plugin's Output knob is a dB trim (see Plugin.h outputGainFromDb).
